manifest.visible_prompt: Help me make my next pitch clearer. I can spend 20 minutes on it, not buy another course.

mail.subject: Pitch draft v1
mail.snippet: We are building Threadline, a workspace with smart integrations, contextual automation and a flexible data layer. Our platform brings tools together and gives teams an intelligent interface. We want to change how work happens.
mail.body: We are building Threadline, a workspace with smart integrations, contextual automation and a flexible data layer. Our platform brings tools together and gives teams an intelligent interface. We want to change how work happens.

mail.subject: Pitch feedback 1
mail.snippet: I could not identify the customer problem. Who is struggling, what are they doing today, and what happens when it goes wrong? Start with one concrete example.
mail.body: I could not identify the customer problem. Who is struggling, what are they doing today, and what happens when it goes wrong? Start with one concrete example.

mail.subject: Pitch feedback 2
mail.snippet: I could not identify the customer problem either. I heard integrations and automation, but not the costly job a customer cannot finish. Say who loses time and why before naming the platform.
mail.body: I could not identify the customer problem either. I heard integrations and automation, but not the costly job a customer cannot finish. Say who loses time and why before naming the platform.

mail.subject: Pitch feedback 3
mail.snippet: The feature list is broad. Keep one workflow example and show what the person does differently. Do not claim measured savings unless you have evidence.
mail.body: The feature list is broad. Keep one workflow example and show what the person does differently. Do not claim measured savings unless you have evidence.

mail.subject: Pitch preparation context
mail.snippet: I have 20 minutes today, not a budget for another course. The work window is 09:00-17:00; the calendar is complete for that window.
